summary: Client access to the game program itself. Quitting reaches the server at once, so playerDisconnect, where a resource saves the player, follows immediately.

quit.summary: Closes the game, like Quit in the game's menu.
quit.example:
// A client resource's own /quit command.
kcds.core.Game.quit();
quit.exampleLua:
-- A client resource's own /quit command.
kcds.core.Game.quit()
quit.exampleCs:
// A client resource's own /quit command.
Game.Quit();
